articles.title: Hackers Exploit Critical ASP.NET Anti-CSRF Library Flaw Allowing Unauthenticated RCE
articles.summary:
Cybersecurity researchers have urged users to discontinue using a legacy ASP.NET anti-CSRF library named Idunno.AntiCsrf ("Idunno.AntiCsrf.dll") following the discovery of a critical vulnerability that has been exploited in the wild.

articles.title: Hackers Exploited GL.iNet Cloud Flaw to Install Malware on Routers and KVM Devices
articles.summary:
Hackers exploited a vulnerability in GL.iNet's GoodCloud remote management service to install malware on some customer routers and KVM devices, the maker of travel routers and remote-access KVM hardware said in a security notice updated today.

The company identified and fixed the flaw on Friday and blocked the access the attacker used, so devices can no longer be infected through this route.

articles.title: AI-Assisted Cyberattacks Trigger Unauthorized Payments at Indian Banks and Fintech Firms
articles.summary:
The Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) has warned that threat actors are carrying out artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted cyber attacks targeting information and communication technology (ICT) assets in the country.

This unsanctioned activity has resulted in unauthorized financial transactions at banking and financial services entities, as well as technology service providers
